Class Job

java.lang.Object
com.qm.bupt.entity.Job
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public class Job extends Object implements Serializable
Job posting entity representing a TA position published by an MO.

Contains job details such as title, type, description, working hours, recruitment quota, deadline, and status. Each job is associated with a publisher (MO) and optionally tagged with skill requirements.
